basic_details.job_title: Zilla Parishad Dharashiv Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 4 Ayush Medical Officer & Other Posts
basic_details.post_name: District Programme Manager (National Ayush Mission), Ayush Medical Officer (PG), Yoga and Naturopathy Expert and 1 more
basic_details.short_information: District Integrated Health and Family Welfare Society, Zilla Parishad Dharashiv (National Ayush Mission), Maharashtra, has invited applications for 4 posts in 4 roles under Advt No. 1. The posts include District Programme Manager (National Ayush Mission), Ayush Medical Officer (PG), Yoga and Naturopathy Expert, Pharmacist / Dietitian. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 27 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Fill the application form in the format attached to the advertisement, in English, with the name as on the SSC or similar certificate.
Attach a demand draft of Rs. 150/- (Open) or Rs. 100/- (Reserved) in favour of DISTRICT HEALTH AND FW SOCIETY OSBD OTHER PROGRAM, with name and post written on its back.
Enclose self-attested photocopies of educational documents and attested copies of other documents.
Submit in person or by post during office hours (except holidays) from 17-11-2026 to 27-11-2026 till 6:15 PM.
Address it to the District Health Officer, National Ayush Mission, Health Department, Second Floor, Zilla Parishad, Dharashiv - 413501.
For more than one post, send a separate application and separate demand draft for each post.
important_instructions: Candidates registered with the employment exchange or other offices must also apply separately. Lists and all updates are published on the NHM Zilla Parishad Dharashiv notice board and https://dharashiv.maharashtra.gov.in/; no separate SMS, email or call. Postal applications are accepted only up to the last date. Documents received after the application period are not accepted. Number of posts, reservation and posting places may change; recruitment may be postponed or cancelled.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for Zilla Parishad Dharashiv Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Age relaxation, District Programme Manager (National Ayush Mission): Reserved categories upper limit 43 years, Employees already working under NHM no age bar for another post within NHM. Age relaxation, Ayush Medical Officer (PG): Employees already working under NHM no age bar for another post within NHM. Age relaxation, Yoga and Naturopathy Expert: Employees already working under NHM no age bar for another post within NHM. Age relaxation, Pharmacist / Dietitian: Employees already working under NHM no age bar for another post within NHM. Other conditions: Applicants above 60 years must produce a physical fitness certificate certified by the civil surgeon. NHM employees should not have any administrative, financial, penal or criminal proceedings during previous government service. Only experience gained after acquiring the prescribed qualification is counted; trainee experience is not counted. Retired government officers/employees must give service details, last pay and pension in the application. Desirable: Exposure in social sector schemes/mission at national, state and district level. Computer knowledge including MS Office, MS Word, MS Power Point, MS Excel.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Posts are purely contractual, not regular state government posts; no claim to permanency. Government service rules do not apply; no claim to absorption in regular government service. Posts are not related to NHM / NUHM; no claim to absorption in NHM / NUHM / 15th Finance Commission if the scheme closes. Service end age 65 years for Medical Officer Ayush and patient-care posts, with annual fitness certificate after 60; 60 years for other programme posts. Selected candidates must submit an agreement on Rs. 100/- bond paper in the prescribed format.

content_sections.text: Merit list on marks out of 100 Marks in the qualifying examination (final year): up to 50 marks Higher qualification in the same subject: up to 20 marks Relevant experience: 6 marks per year, maximum 30 marks Qualifying exam marks (final year): 50% proportion of percentage, maximum 50 marks Higher qualification in the same subject: 20% proportion of percentage, maximum 20 marks Related government/private experience: 6 marks per year, maximum 30 marks Total 100 marks; on equal marks the older candidate gets preference
